My Story

I am a Nigerian girl who came to America when I was two years old. Growing up between two cultures has shaped who I am today. At home, I was surrounded by Nigerian traditions, food, and values, while outside of home I learned how to adapt to life in America. Because of this, I learned how to balance different parts of my identity and stay open-minded to new experiences.

One thing that describes me best is that I love being busy. I enjoy staying active and always trying something new. Whether it is playing sports, cooking, learning instruments, drawing, or attending educational events, I like challenging myself and learning in different ways. I do not enjoy sitting still for too long because I feel happiest when I am growing, creating, or improving at something.

Sports have taught me discipline and teamwork, especially through activities like girls flag football and powerlifting. Drawing and creative activities allow me to express myself, while cooking helps me connect with my culture and creativity at the same time. I also enjoy educational programs and events because I like learning beyond the classroom and meeting people with different ideas and experiences.

I also hope that one day I will be able to travel the world and experience new cultures, places, and opportunities. I want to continue learning from different people and trying new things because I believe there is always something new to discover.

Overall, I see myself as a curious, hardworking, and creative person. I always want to improve myself, try new opportunities, and continue learning more about both the world and myself.

Open Project

Classroom Phone Game Demo

This game is not finished and still in progress but it’s still pretty fun. This is influenced by those android games you see in ads where it’s like don’t get caught using your phone. Basically the game in a nutshell is, you have 3 bars for hydration, business and level bar. Both your hydration bar and business bar go down gradually. You drink water to bring up the hydration bar and using the paper brings up the business bar. Your level up bar increases when you use your phone but your business bar decreases a lot. When your business bar is completely down the teacher confronts you and you get detention which is game over. It’s also game over if you die from dehydration. Like I said it’s all in progress so this is more like a demo.

AP Create Task Cooking Game

This is the game I made for my AP Create Task. There are slight bugs in the game but still playable. Also there are no instructions and it’s a little confusing if you're not me who made the game. It’s a very simple, basic “cooking” game. You get a challenge, which is what you're going to cook and you search that word(s) verbatim in the learn button and click ingredients. You have to remember the directions or you can keep typing the recipe name after clicking ingredients. You have to find and click the ingredients in the same order you see when you type for ingredients. After getting all the ingredients you press done and a new challenge appears. If it’s wrong you lose. I didn’t finish this game and when you get it wrong or right the ingredients you click never come back so you can only make one dish.
